headline: Seven leans on the wet glass.
body: Buses idle with their lights still half-asleep. A baker's van leaves a warm rectangle of air on the corner and then is gone. The river, if you listen, is only a rumour under the traffic.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: low stratus, colour of unwashed linen

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: gutter running clear, one lost glove

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: shopfronts waking in sequence west to east
